post.title: Mortgage rates fell again to 7.18%. Here's the catch
post.ig:
Mortgage rates fell again, to 7.18%. The catch?
Freddie Mac: the 30-year fixed averaged 7.18% on Nov 5, 2026, down from 7.24%, its third straight weekly drop.
A year ago it was 6.22%. It peaked at 7.4% in early October, the highest in nearly three years (AP).
Our math: on a $400,000 loan, about $2,710 a month vs $2,455 a year ago, roughly $255 more.
Sources: Freddie Mac PMMS (Nov 5, 2026), AP (Nov 5, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
